custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'eyespot' geometry. In AI images, these often become irregular blobs rather than perfect circles with pupils. Check if the yellow rings are continuous or broken. Also, verify if the shadow cast by the butterfly onto the leaf is physically consistent with the light source direction implied by the highlights on the wing.
image_description: A close-up macro shot of a brown butterfly, identified as a Ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on a green leaf. The wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is characterized by a uniform brown color and a row of distinct eyespots (ocelli) with yellow rings and black centers along the hindwing margin. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green.

expert_testimonies.reason: To confirm the specific species identification (Ringlet vs. other Browns/Satyrids) based on the ocelli pattern and wing shade.
To audit the sharpness of the wing edges against the background and check for any 'halo' effects or bleeding artifacts common in AI generation.
To evaluate the overall coherence of lighting, shadow casting on the leaf, and texture consistency of the wing scales.
